#ad This plush seat sticks straight to the glass using strong suction cups, requiring zero drilling or tools. It gives indoor cats a cozy front-row spot for watching neighborhood birds and rain showers. Just measure your window pane first to ensure a proper fit for your small or medium feline.

brief: Suction-cup cat window hammock: a soft plush seat that sticks to a window with suction cups, no drilling. Gives an indoor cat a sunny spot to watch birds and rain. Check your window size first; not for very heavy cats. Playful tone: like a property listing for a cat's sunny window seat.
